chief_complaint: Follow-up for hypertension, obesity, prediabetes, anemia, and anxiety

Blood pressure is borderline controlled (126/84 mmHg). Obesity (BMI ≥30) was documented in 2019 and persists. Prediabetes was identified in 2019 with a recent HbA1c of 6.2%. Anemia has been present since late 2022 without documented work‑up or treatment. Severe panic‑type anxiety began in late 2023 and is unmanaged pharmacologically. Socially, the patient reports limited contact and part‑time employment since 2023, suggesting possible psychosocial stressors. Recent wellness visits have not yielded updated BMI, lipid panel, renal function, or iron studies, leaving several risk domains incompletely evaluated.
